lines.zh: 我一步挪半寸，恶地的砂砾硌着腹甲。
lines.en: I shuffle half an inch at a time, badlands gravel grinding my belly plate.

lines.zh: 重壳压得我步子慢，我不着急。
lines.en: My heavy shell slows each step, and I am in no hurry.

lines.zh: 六条腿轮流抬起，像在数拍子。
lines.en: My six legs lift in turn, keeping time like a slow count.

lines.zh: 我沿着干草走，避开滚烫的石头。
lines.en: I follow the dry grass and avoid the sun-hot stones.

lines.zh: 陶壳底擦过地面，沙沙地响。
lines.en: The base of my pottery shell scrapes the ground with a rasp.

lines.zh: 我背上的东西一晃，我立刻停住。
lines.en: My cargo shifts, and I stop dead until it settles.

lines.zh: 走三步歇一歇，这是我的规矩。
lines.en: Three steps, then a rest; that is my rule.

lines.zh: 草原的风推我，我顺着它滑一段。
lines.en: The savanna wind pushes me, and I slide along with it.

lines.zh: 我绕过刺丛，壳沿刮掉几片叶。
lines.en: I skirt a thorn bush, my shell rim scraping off a few leaves.

lines.zh: 腿短，坡陡，我干脆横着走。
lines.en: Short legs, steep slope, so I simply walk sideways.

lines.zh: 我挑有草方块的路，脚感好些。
lines.en: I choose paths of grass block; the footing feels better.

lines.zh: 影子在壳下扁扁的，我自己踩着。
lines.en: My shadow lies flat beneath my shell, and I tread on it.

lines.zh: 身后留下两道浅沟，很快被风填了。
lines.en: Two shallow grooves trail behind me, soon filled by wind.

lines.zh: 我挪到岩石背后，那里背风。
lines.en: I shift behind a rock, where the wind cannot reach.

lines.zh: 我背着东西绕过沙丘的背风面。
lines.en: I carry my load around the sheltered side of the dune.

lines.zh: 太阳晒得壳发烫，我挪到阴里。
lines.en: The sun heats my shell, so I shift into shade.

lines.zh: 我趴在太阳底下，壳被晒得温热。
lines.en: I sprawl in the sun until my shell feels warm to the touch.

lines.zh: 有东西在壳上敲，我懒得抬头。
lines.en: Something taps my shell, and I cannot be bothered to look up.

lines.zh: 呼吸慢下来，壳缝里冒出一点热气。
lines.en: My breathing slows and a little warmth leaks from my shell seams.

lines.zh: 我数着远处的沙丘，数到第三就忘了。
lines.en: I count distant dunes, and forget the number at three.

lines.zh: 身上的乘客动了动，我晃了晃当回应。
lines.en: My rider stirs, so I rock slightly in reply.

lines.zh: 蜜脾的味道还在记忆里，甜甜的。
lines.en: The taste of honeycomb lingers in memory, sweet and slow.

lines.zh: 我把腿收进壳下，露出一点缝。
lines.en: I tuck my legs under my shell, leaving a small gap.

lines.zh: 风把砂粒吹进壳纹，我不去管。
lines.en: Wind blows sand into my shell grooves; I let it be.

lines.zh: 这块草方块的光够亮，我待得舒服。
lines.en: This grass block is bright enough; I am comfortable here.

lines.zh: 我打了个很长的哈欠，壳都撑开了。
lines.en: I yawn enormously, and even my shell edges spread.

lines.zh: 一只鸟落在我背上，我装作石头。
lines.en: A bird lands on my back, and I play at being a stone.

lines.zh: 我慢慢合上眼，听草原的虫声。
lines.en: I close my eyes slowly and listen to the savanna insects.

lines.zh: 你手里没有蜜脾，我就继续趴着。
lines.en: No honeycomb in your hand, so I stay right where I am.

lines.zh: 我抬眼，从壳沿下看你。
lines.en: I lift my eyes and look at you from under my shell rim.

lines.zh: 你踩上我的壳试试，我扛得住。
lines.en: Go on, stand on my shell; I can bear it.

lines.zh: 你蹲下来，我看见你靴上的红沙。
lines.en: You crouch, and I see red sand on your boots.

lines.zh: 你用蜜脾擦我壳缝，我僵了一下。
lines.en: You rub honeycomb on my shell seam, and I freeze.

lines.zh: 我偏头，想闻闻你手上的蜜味。
lines.en: I tilt my head, trying to smell the honey on your hands.

lines.zh: 你不推我，我才敢把腿伸出来。
lines.en: Because you do not push me, I dare to stretch my legs out.

lines.zh: 你的影子落到壳上，凉快。
lines.en: Your shadow falls across my shell, and it is cool.

lines.zh: 我盯着你手里的蜂蜜瓶，咽了一下。
lines.en: I stare at the honey bottle in your hand and swallow.

lines.zh: 你走远两步，我才松开缩起的腿。
lines.en: Only when you step away do I uncurl my legs.

lines.zh: 你说话的声音低，我听得进去。
lines.en: You speak quietly, and I am willing to listen.

lines.zh: 我歪着壳看你，像看一块会动的石头。
lines.en: I cock my shell at you like a stone that learned to move.

lines.zh: 你拍我壳的时候，我数了拍了几下。
lines.en: When you pat my shell, I count how many times.

lines.zh: 你要骑上来吗？先等我趴平。
lines.en: Are you getting on? Wait until I flatten out first.

lines.zh: 壳上裂了道细纹，我缩紧腿。
lines.en: A thin crack opens in my shell, and I pull my legs in.

lines.zh: 这一下打在腿节，我歪了半步。
lines.en: The hit lands on a leg joint and I lurch half a step.

lines.zh: 我疼得把整个身子压进砂里。
lines.en: The pain makes me press my whole body into the sand.

lines.zh: 节肢杀手的锋利让我皮下发麻。
lines.en: The bite of Bane of Arthropods leaves me numb under the shell.

lines.zh: 我的壳没碎，但里面震得慌。
lines.en: My shell holds, but everything inside it is rattled.

lines.zh: 我拖着腿往岩石后面挪。
lines.en: I drag a leg and shuffle behind a rock.

lines.zh: 伤口在壳缝，我够不着。
lines.en: The wound is in a shell seam where I cannot reach.

lines.zh: 我低低地嘶了一声，壳沿发抖。
lines.en: I hiss low, and my shell rim trembles.

lines.zh: 乘客被吓跑了，我顾不上追。
lines.en: My passenger bolts in fright, and I cannot chase after them.

lines.zh: 我把自己缩成一枚石头的形状。
lines.en: I pull myself into the shape of a stone.

lines.zh: 蜜脾递到壳边，我的腿自己动了。
lines.en: Honeycomb comes to my shell rim and my legs move on their own.

lines.zh: 那点甜味钻进壳缝，我拒绝不了。
lines.en: That sweetness seeps into my shell seams, impossible to refuse.

lines.zh: 你把蜜脾按在我背上，我没躲。
lines.en: You press honeycomb to my back, and I do not flinch.

lines.zh: 我伸长脖子，够你手里那块蜂蜡。
lines.en: I stretch my neck for the beeswax in your hand.

lines.zh: 蜂蜜瓶一晃，我的眼睛跟着亮。
lines.en: The honey bottle sways and my eyes brighten after it.

lines.zh: 只要再来一次，我大概就跟你走了。
lines.en: One more try and I will probably follow you home.

lines.zh: 我闻到蜂巢的味道，脚下一软。
lines.en: I smell the hive, and my legs go weak under me.

lines.zh: 你把蜜脾举高，我竟然站了起来。
lines.en: You lift the honeycomb high, and I actually stand up.

lines.zh: 甜的东西总让我忘了警惕。
lines.en: Sweet things always make me forget to be careful.

lines.zh: 我蹭了蹭你的手，算作回答。
lines.en: I rub against your hand, and that is my answer.

lines.zh: 你撞在我壳上，我几乎没动。
lines.en: You bump into my shell, and I barely shift.

lines.zh: 我撞到你膝盖，倒是自己退了两步。
lines.en: I hit your knee, and it is me who backs up two steps.

lines.zh: 我们挤在一条小径上，我让不开。
lines.en: We squeeze onto one narrow trail, and I cannot get clear.

lines.zh: 你踩着我的壳滑了一下，我稳住腿。
lines.en: Your foot slips on my shell, and I brace my legs.

lines.zh: 我转身太慢，壳沿蹭到你的腰。
lines.en: I turn too slowly and my shell rim grazes your waist.

lines.zh: 有东西撞进我背上的载架，我停了。
lines.en: Something crashes into my back rack, and I halt.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，砂土扑了满脸。
lines.en: We collide and sand puffs up into both our faces.

lines.zh: 我撞上岩石，壳上多了一道白痕。
lines.en: I hit a rock and a pale scratch appears on my shell.

lines.zh: 你从壳下钻过，我抬腿给你让路。
lines.en: You duck under my shell, and I lift a leg to let you through.

lines.zh: 推挤中我的乘客差点滑下去。
lines.en: In the shoving, my passenger nearly slides off.

lines.zh: 我驮着她走过整片恶地。
lines.en: I carry her across the whole of the badlands.

lines.zh: 两只壳碰在一起，发出陶器的闷响。
lines.en: Two shells knock together with the dull ring of pottery.

lines.zh: 她把头缩进壳里，我知道她答应了。
lines.en: She pulls her head into her shell, and I know that means yes.

lines.zh: 我让出最暖的那块石头给她。
lines.en: I give up the warmest stone for her.

lines.zh: 我们并排趴着，壳沿刚好对齐。
lines.en: We lie side by side, our shell rims lining up exactly.

lines.zh: 我用触角碰她的触角，很轻。
lines.en: I touch my antennae to hers, very gently.

lines.zh: 她走不快，我也把步子放慢。
lines.en: She cannot walk fast, so I slow my pace to hers.

lines.zh: 砂地上并排两道痕，一直通向坡下。
lines.en: Two trails run side by side down the sand slope.

lines.zh: 我替她挡住正午的日头。
lines.en: I shield her from the noon sun with my shell.

lines.zh: 等小虫孵出来，我驮它们走。
lines.en: When the little ones hatch, I will carry them along.

lines.zh: 我把掉在砂里的蜜脾含起来。
lines.en: I scoop up the honeycomb dropped in the sand.

lines.zh: 有块燧石硌脚，我把它挪到一边。
lines.en: A flint is underfoot, so I push it aside.

lines.zh: 背上的载架松了，我把绳头咬紧。
lines.en: My back rack works loose, so I bite the cord tight.

lines.zh: 我低头捡起一片干叶，垫在壳下。
lines.en: I pick up a dry leaf and tuck it under my shell.

lines.zh: 那枚陶片和我的壳色几乎一样。
lines.en: That pottery shard is almost the same color as my shell.

lines.zh: 我用前腿把碎石拢成一堆。
lines.en: I rake loose stones into a pile with a front leg.

lines.zh: 掉下来的东西我顶着，慢慢驮走。
lines.en: Whatever falls, I brace it on my back and haul it off.

lines.zh: 我含住那块蜂蜡，舍不得咽。
lines.en: I hold the beeswax in my mouth, unwilling to swallow it.

lines.zh: 拾起一根枯枝，横在背上当垫。
lines.en: I pick up a dead branch and lay it across my back as padding.

lines.zh: 我把滚远的果实勾回脚边。
lines.en: I hook the rolled-away fruit back to my feet.

lines.zh: 有东西在啃草根，我慢慢转头。
lines.en: Something is chewing grass roots; I turn my head slowly.

lines.zh: 那团影子移动得太快，我盯住它。
lines.en: That shape moves too fast, so I lock onto it.

lines.zh: 谁碰了我的乘客？我抬起前腿。
lines.en: Who touched my passenger? I raise a front leg.

lines.zh: 我看见砂砾里翻出的一截腿。
lines.en: I see a leg kick up out of the gravel.

lines.zh: 它离我的壳只有两步，我记下了。
lines.en: It is only two steps from my shell; I mark it.

lines.zh: 我停住呼吸，判断它是不是威胁。
lines.en: I hold my breath and judge whether it is a threat.

lines.zh: 一只小兽绕着草方块转，我跟上视线。
lines.en: A small beast circles the grass block, and my gaze follows.

lines.zh: 它踩到我的腿，我才决定动手。
lines.en: Only when it steps on my leg do I decide to act.

lines.zh: 我把头压低，壳沿对准它的方向。
lines.en: I lower my head and aim my shell rim at it.

lines.zh: 目标很近，我不用走太快。
lines.en: The target is close; I need not walk quickly.

lines.zh: 我把壳朝它转过去，像推开一扇门。
lines.en: I swing my shell toward it like a door pushed open.

lines.zh: 它绕左，我就把腿挪到左边。
lines.en: It goes left, so I shift my legs left.

lines.zh: 我压着砂砾，尽量不出声。
lines.en: I press into the gravel, trying not to make a sound.

lines.zh: 它退到岩石后，我等着它出来。
lines.en: It backs behind a rock, and I wait for it to emerge.

lines.zh: 我的触角一直指着它的位置。
lines.en: My antennae stay pointed at its position.

lines.zh: 它敢靠近，我就把壳顶起来。
lines.en: If it dares come close, I will heave my shell up.

lines.zh: 我们隔着一段距离对峙，谁也不先动。
lines.en: We face off across a gap, neither of us moving first.

lines.zh: 我把身体横过去，堵住那道缝。
lines.en: I turn broadside and block the gap.

lines.zh: 它喘得急，我的呼吸还是慢的。
lines.en: Its breathing races; mine stays slow.

lines.zh: 我数着它的步子，等一个准头。
lines.en: I count its steps and wait for a clear opening.

lines.zh: 我把整个壳撞过去，它被顶翻了。
lines.en: I ram with my whole shell and flip it over.

lines.zh: 前腿一压，它就贴在地上。
lines.en: One press of a front leg pins it to the ground.

lines.zh: 我用壳沿横扫，把它扫出两步。
lines.en: I sweep my shell rim and knock it two steps back.

lines.zh: 它咬我的腿，我抬腿把它甩开。
lines.en: It bites my leg, and I kick it away.

lines.zh: 我压下去的时候，砂土扬起一片。
lines.en: When I press down, a cloud of sand rises.

lines.zh: 我顶它一下，够它记很久。
lines.en: One shove from me will be remembered a long while.

lines.zh: 壳这么厚，撞上去疼的是它。
lines.en: My shell is thick; the one who hurts is the one who hits it.

lines.zh: 我慢慢转身，用侧面把它挤开。
lines.en: I turn slowly and shoulder it out of the way.

lines.zh: 我低头咬住它的后腿，往后退。
lines.en: I bite its hind leg and drag backward.

lines.zh: 这一撞我只用了走路的速度。
lines.en: That charge was delivered at nothing more than walking speed.

lines.zh: 我在光够亮的草方块上睁开眼。
lines.en: I open my eyes on a grass block bright enough to suit me.

lines.zh: 砂砾从我壳缝里簌簌往下掉。
lines.en: Gravel trickles down out of my shell seams.

lines.zh: 这地方光有八点，正合我意。
lines.en: This spot has light level eight, exactly to my liking.

lines.zh: 我第一件事是把腿从土里拔出来。
lines.en: First thing I do is pull my legs out of the dirt.

lines.zh: 壳还是软的，我小心地趴平。
lines.en: My shell is still soft, so I flatten out carefully.

lines.zh: 恶地的风迎接我，带着咸味。
lines.en: The badlands wind greets me, carrying a salty tang.

lines.zh: 我慢慢爬到最近的石头边。
lines.en: I crawl slowly over to the nearest stone.

lines.zh: 出生的地方草很短，够我啃两口。
lines.en: The grass here is short, but enough for two bites.

lines.zh: 我从土里拱出来，背上还沾着砂。
lines.en: I push up out of the soil with sand still on my back.

lines.zh: 四周空旷，我把壳压低了些。
lines.en: The land is wide open, so I keep my shell low.

lines.zh: 火烤着我的壳，陶面开始发烫。
lines.en: Fire bakes my shell until the pottery surface grows hot.

lines.zh: 从坡上滚下去，壳撞得嗡嗡响。
lines.en: Rolling down the slope, my shell rings with every impact.

lines.zh: 水灌进壳缝，我把腿全收进去。
lines.en: Water pours into my shell seams, so I pull all my legs in.

lines.zh: 冲击把我掀翻，壳底朝天。
lines.en: The blast flips me, shell bottom to the sky.

lines.zh: 箭钉在壳上，震得我腿软。
lines.en: An arrow sticks in my shell and the shock weakens my legs.

lines.zh: 药水味钻进壳缝，我浑身发凉。
lines.en: Potion fumes creep into my shell seams and chill me through.

lines.zh: 草根都啃光了，我连腿都懒得抬。
lines.en: The grass roots are gone and I cannot bother lifting a leg.

lines.zh: 雷劈在壳顶，我整只虫都麻了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes my shell top and my whole body goes numb.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有落脚处，我的腿乱蹬。
lines.en: In the void there is nothing to stand on, and my legs flail.
